req.title: Reject negative skip
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the skip parameter is negative.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-006 requires HTTP 422 when skip < 0. The violation was test[3] (test_skip_negative_two_returns_422) having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. The rule requires that negative-kind tests do not use EP (Equivalence Partitioning is a partitioning heuristic, not a negative-test heuristic). Fix: change heuristic from EP to NEG for that test, which correctly classifies it as a negative test using the NEG heuristic (testing invalid input expecting an error). All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_skip_zero_returns_200
expected: Response body is a JSON array (empty list)
trace: R-TASK-006: skip=0 is the minimum valid value (ge=0), must NOT be rejected
BVA: lower boundary of valid partition; catches mutation ge=0 -> gt=0
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_zero_returns_200():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == []

test_skip_zero_returns_200()

tests.name: test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero
expected: The two status codes are different, confirming the boundary at 0
trace: R-TASK-006: boundary at ge=0; BVA ±1 around threshold
BVA + comparison-mutation: catches ge->gt (would reject 0) and ge->le (would accept -1)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero():
    r_invalid = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r_invalid.status_code == 422
    r_valid = client.get("/tasks/?skip=0")
    assert r_valid.status_code == 200
    assert r_invalid.status_code != r_valid.status_code

test_skip_boundary_minus_one_vs_zero()

tests.name: test_skip_negative_two_returns_422
expected: detail list contains at least one entry referencing 'skip' or 'query'
trace: R-TASK-006: any negative skip must be rejected; -2 is in the same invalid partition as -1
NEG: confirms the entire negative input space is rejected, not just -1 specifically; kills constant-mutation on the -1 literal
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_negative_two_returns_422():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-2")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    errors = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(errors, list)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    locs = [str(e.get("loc", "")) for e in errors]
    assert any("skip" in loc for loc in locs)

test_skip_negative_two_returns_422()

tests.name: test_skip_negative_validation_error_structure
actions: Inspect the full validation error payload structure
expected: detail[0]['type'] is a non-empty string (validation error type)
trace: R-TASK-006: error payload must be well-formed; DT covers the combination of negative skip + expected error structure
DT + constant-mutation: exact field names in error response kill attribute-name mutations
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_skip_negative_validation_error_structure():
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    detail = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(detail, list)
    assert len(detail) >= 1
    first_error = detail[0]
    assert "loc" in first_error
    assert "skip" in first_error["loc"]
    assert "msg" in first_error
    assert len(first_error["msg"]) > 0
    assert "type" in first_error
    assert len(first_error["type"]) > 0

test_skip_negative_validation_error_structure()
